card.name: Start of the word biopsy
card.fires_on: The word piece " bi" that starts "biopsy", "biopsies" or "biologic" in drug-label text, especially after tissue, skin, muscle or nerve. It also fires weakly on a few odd spots in sputum and study-method text.

modes.label: Biopsy start
modes.description: The opening piece of biopsy/biopsies/biopsied after a tissue or organ word.
modes.example: Skin lesions not typical for psoriasis should be<< bi>>opsied before starting cyclospor

modes.label: Biologic fluids
modes.description: The opening piece of biologic in the phrase about drug concentration in biologic fluids.
modes.example: No information is available on the median lethal dose of the drug or the concentration of methimazole in<< bi>>ologic fluids associated with toxicity and/or death

modes.label: Sputum or date text
modes.description: Weaker hits on pieces of words in sputum-collection or study-date sentences.
modes.example: The first 2 sputum samples or garg<<le>> specimens were cultured

card.writes: It seems to push against words like bulk and free, with no clear positive theme.
card.plain: It marks the beginning of the word biopsy or biologic in clinical text.
